{{Quote|Greetings. I am Captain Treidum of the New Republic vessel ''Lance of Endor''. We've come from the Galactic Core to eradicate your people.|Captain Rolf Treidum, posing as a New Republic emissary|<ref name="ge">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Galaxy's Edge|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>}}
'''Rolf Treidum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During his service while stationed in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], Treidum encountered a young [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Kentor Sarne]] and became one of his staunchest supporters. As a result, when Sarne was appointed as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], Treidum transferred to the [[Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet]] and [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Lialic II]]''. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]&mdash;a battle that also claimed the life of Treidum's only [[Rolf Treidum's son|son]]&mdash;Treidum served Moff Sarne as he withdrew the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and set himself up as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], Treidum and the ''Lialic II'' retreated with Sarne into the deep regions of the Kathol sector.

However, when Sarne learned that the New Republic had dispatched the CR90 corvette ''[[FarStar]]'' to [[DarkStryder Campaign|track him down]], he ordered Treidum and the ''Lialic II'' to return to the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]] and delay the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] as much as possible. Although Sarne wished the ''FarStar'' to locate him and call in a New Republic strike force, he wanted it to be on his own timetable, and at a place of his choosing. He planned to destroy the New Republic regional forces in one fell swoop, allowing him to reclaim the sector unopposed. As such, Treidum was ordered to only stall the vessel, and not destroy it. Renaming the ''Lialic II'' as the ''[[Lialic II|Lance of Endor]]'', Treidum posed as a New Republic officer to stir up resentment for the New Republic and the ''FarStar'' by portraying the government as a totalitarian regime that wished to bring all planets under its dominion. Treidum fooled several governments with this ruse, including the [[Kathol Republic]] and the leaders of the planet [[Danoor]]. While Treidum did succeed in delaying the ''FarStar'' during its trip through the Kathol Outback, he was unable to enjoy his victory as he was killed during the [[Battle of Danoor]], when the ''Lialic II'' was rammed by an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Sanhedrim ship]].

==Biography==
===Imperial service===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rolf Treidum served with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces stationed in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and met an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Kentor Sarne]] during this period. Treidum was quick to ally himself with the ambitious young man, a move that would tie his future career to Sarne's. At some point, Treidum [[Reproduction/Legends|fathered]] a [[Rolf Treidum's son|son]], who would follow in his father's footsteps and join the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="KO" />

[[File:KentorSarne.png|thumb|left|200px|Kentor Sarne]]
Kentor Sarne was appointed as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], and Treidum was transferred to the [[Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet]] sometime after. Serving under Sarne, he commanded the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Lialic II]]'', one of several such [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] operating with Sarne's forces.<ref name="KO" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|engaged]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces over the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> During the battle, which saw the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]],<ref name="rotj" /> Treidum's only son was killed.<ref name="KO" />

Treidum continued to serve with Sarne as the Moff quietly withdrew the Kathol sector from the Empire, setting himself up as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] by taking advantage of the confusion in the Imperial command structure following the death of the Emperor.<ref name="KO" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched an [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|assault]] on Sarne's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. During the fighting, Sarne was able to escape into the Kathol sector with the majority of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]],<ref name="tsb">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> including Treidum and the ''Lialic II''.<ref name="KO" />

===A new mission===
{{Quote|You are ordered to return to the Kathol Outback region and locate the New Republic ship ''FarStar''.|Extract from Moff Kentor Sarne's orders to Captain Rolf Treidum|<ref name="KO" />}}
Moff Sarne learned that the New Republic had sent a single ship after him, assigned to [[DarkStryder Campaign|track him down]] and attempt to neutralize any threat he posed to the security of the region. Unfortunately for the New Republic, the ship they had tasked with the mission, the ''[[FarStar]]'', had originally been part of Sarne's forces. Formerly known as the ''Renegade'', the ship had been in the middle of an extensive series of modifications. One such modification allowed Sarne to track the vessel's location at all times.<ref name="tdc">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

[[File:FarStar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''FarStar'', Treidum's quarry]]
Although Sarne intended for the ''FarStar'' to follow him, and thus bring about a larger confrontation with New Republic forces at a place of his choosing, the Moff needed to ensure that the corvette kept to a timetable of his design. Sarne's plan was to completely crush the New Republic forces assigned to the Kathol sector, which in turn would allow him to regain control of his former holdings and reoccupy his capital, Kal'Shebbol, unopposed. He could not allow the ''FarStar'' to discover his location too early, nor dissuade them enough to force them to abandon their mission through lack of success. As a result, Sarne ordered Treidum to detach the ''Lialic II'' from his forces, and return to the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. There, Treidum's orders were clear&mdash;delay the ''FarStar'' by any means necessary, deny the New Republic any potential allies by stirring up resentment against them, but under no circumstances was the corvette to be destroyed or crippled so that it could not complete its mission. If the ''FarStar'' was destroyed by means beyond Treidum's control, Sarne expected a full report proving the [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] innocence in the matter.<ref name="KO" />

===Opposing the ''FarStar''===
{{Quote|&hellip; will be pleased, Captain Treidum, with the results. I suspect your idea of &hellip; shall yield us handsome dividends. Pray continue to encourage the belief that &hellip; will be joining you in the Episol system shortly to observe your handiwork first-hand as planned.|Kentor Sarne, in a transmission to Rolf Treidum designed to be intercepted by the ''FarStar''|<ref name="le">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Little Empires|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>}}
Treidum devised a plan to accomplish both tasks at once. He renamed the ''Lialic II'' as the ''[[Lialic II|Lance of Endor]]'', realizing the irony in associating the vessel's alias with the place where his son perished. Posing as an emissary of the New Republic, he approached several Outback [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. After welcoming them into the New Republic, he then made impossible demands of the local population. When they did not&mdash;or could not&mdash;comply, he attacked them with the ''Lialic II''{{'s}} weapons. Treidum's plan worked, turning several neutral planets against the New Republic.<ref name="KO" />

Sarne ordered Treidum to delay the ''FarStar'' in the [[Kathol Republic]], a small pocket empire centered in the [[Episol system]]. Treidum's reconnaissance of the union indicated that the [[Kathol Republic Navy|Kathol Republic's navy]] was enough to threaten the ''FarStar''. Arriving in the Episol system, Treidum demanded the annexation of all Kathol Republic worlds, a fifty percent tax on products and resources, the forced sterilization of all colonists, and the replacement of all elected officials with appointed New Republic representatives. After reporting his plan and his actions to Sarne, the Moff lured the ''FarStar'' to the system by intentionally broadcasting his response on a wide-beam transmission that he was sure that the New Republic ship would intercept.<ref name="le" />

[[File:BravadoIII-KatholOutback.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Bravado III'' following its battle with the ''Lialic II'']]
When the Kathol Republic refused to meet his demands, Treidum [[Battle of Episol|attacked]] two of the Republic's [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]], destroying one, and damaging a second, the ''[[Bravado III]]''. While preparing to engage another target, the ''FarStar'' arrived. Treidum withdrew the ''Lialic II'' from the [[Star system/Legends|system]], leaving the ''FarStar'' to deal with the rest of the Kathol Republic Navy. The New Republic corvette surrendered rather than provoke a confrontation, and the vessel was impounded by the Kathol Republic, and her crew taken for trial on the moon of [[Dayark]], the capital of the Republic. Despite being confused over why the Kathol Republic considered the New Republic vessel to be a threat, Captain [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], commander of the ''FarStar'', managed to convince the [[Kathol Republic Senatorial Council]] of their innocence, and exposed a plot to overthrow the elected leadership of the Kathol Republic by one of their own [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. Grateful to the crew of the ''FarStar'', the ship was allowed on its way armed with the information that another corvette was posing as a New Republic vessel, and with the Kathol Republic as a new ally.<ref name="le" />

A short time after the ''Lialic II''{{'s}} mission to Episol, Captain Treidum, acting on the orders of Moff Sarne, ordered a [[Unidentified Gamma-class assault shuttle|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] to a specific set of co-ordinates to rendezvous with the [[Qektoth Confederation]]. The Confederation was a militant order of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and idealists who believed in the purity of organic technology. Sarne had entered into an agreement with them to gain some of their bioweapons in exchange for ships and their crews. The ''Gamma''-class assault [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was subsequently used by the Confederation as a testing ground for their [[Qektoth Confederation biochemical agent|biochemical agent]].<ref name="w">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Wildfire (adventure)|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>

===Final gambit===
Treidum kept to his mission, visiting the planet [[Danoor]] on the edge of the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], demanding the complete surrender of the colony, annual tribute equal to half the planet's gross income, and ten percent of the population to be used as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in the name of the New Republic. While on the planet, he secretly contacted one of the [[Minister]]s on Danoor, [[Waric Nane]]. Nane's [[Politics/Legends|political]] views were in line with those of Sarne's, and Treidum decided that he could use Nane as an ally in his mission against the ''FarStar''. He told him of his true identity and informed him of the benefits of joining with Moff Sarne's Empire. Nane, a proponent of a totalitarian regime, agreed to consider his offer. Treidum provided the Minister with a strange trapezoid device that could be used to contact him in case of an emergency. However, Treidum requested that, if the New Republic should ever turn up at Danoor, then Nane would activate the device and let Treidum know immediately. He was then to find a way to keep them on the planet until Treidum could return.<ref name="ge" />

[[File:Battleofdanoor.jpg|thumb|right|The Battle of Danoor]]
A week after Treidum had made his demands and left Danoor, the device was activated, alerting him that the ''FarStar'' had arrived in the system. The ''Lialic II'', along with an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Danoor)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], returned to the planet. Finding the ''FarStar'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Treidum ordered his ships to attack. Although badly outclassed, the ''FarStar'' was joined by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the [[Danoor Resistance]] in defending the planet. During the subsequent [[Battle of Danoor|battle]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] utilized a new weapon, known as a [[devastator torpedo]], which obliterated a ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] area of the planet and caused the Danoor Resistance fighters to disengage from the battle. However, the arrival of the mysterious [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] swung the battle in the New Republic's favor. They had been called by a message beamed into the Kathol Rift by the ''FarStar'' on behalf of the Danoor Resistance, who were their allies. The Aing-Tii [[Sanhedrim ship]] charged straight for the ''Lialic II'', ramming the ship and completely destroying the corvette with the loss of all hands, including Captain Treidum. With the battle down to the ''FarStar'' against the Star Destroyer, the ''FarStar''{{'s}} own [[FarStar starfighter squadron|fighter complement]] managed to strike the torpedo's launcher, causing a chain reaction explosion that destroyed the vessel. Despite losing his life, Treidum had succeeded in his mission, delaying the ''FarStar'' long enough for Moff Sarne to prepare his forces for their arrival.<ref name="ge" />

==Personality and traits==
Treidum was considered to be a talented and loyal Imperial officer who believed that the end result justified the means by which it was achieved. He was able to present an affable front when it was needed, but it was only to gain an advantage over his enemies.<ref name="KO" /> Pragmatic and practical, Treidum was able to use government factions to his advantage in his mission to harass the ''FarStar'', such as siding with Minister Waric Nane of Danoor and offering Imperial aid to his policies in exchange for delaying the New Republic vessel as much as possible.<ref name="ge" /> Tactically competent, Treidum was able to successfully engage two ''Marauder''-class corvettes in battle with the ''Lialic II'',<ref name="le" /> and was the theater commander during the Battle of Danoor despite the presence of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], a vessel that had tactical superiority over his own corvette.<ref name="ge" /> In his early sixties by the time of his death in 8 ABY, he had dark hair that was only just beginning to go [[Color/Legends|gray]].<ref name="KO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Treidum was trained in the use of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], and was also skilled in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]], the use of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weapons. Able to pilot both [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and space transports, Treidum specialized in Corellian corvettes. He was also able to use the [[Gunner/Legends|weapons]] on capital ships&mdash;with a particular focus on [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]&mdash;and was knowledgeable about their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] systems. Treidum could assist in the repair of capital ships and their weapon systems, and had training in [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] systems and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]]. He was well versed in Imperial law enforcement procedures and security systems, and displayed a understanding of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], languages, other cultures, [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], business, and planetary systems. Treidum could drive [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, and repair them if the need arose. He also had some skill in programming and repairing both [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Treidum also had experience in demolitions and [[Medic/Legends|first aid]].<ref name="KO" />

==Equipment==
Treidum favored an [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] as his personal weapon, and also carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. He generally wore an Imperial officer's uniform, but he had a New Republic uniform to don when he needed to convince the inhabitants of the Kathol Outback that he was representing the New Republic.<ref name="KO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rolf Treidum was created for the supplement ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'' by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Treidum served as the major Imperial antagonist for the crew of the ''FarStar'' in several adventures, although he wasn't encountered directly until the final scenario, ''[[Galaxy's Edge]]'', in which he met his end.
